title: Rules lane on policies + AI-writing tells pack
description:
Rebuild the deterministic lane on policies.

## Scope
- Detector kinds: `regex`, `lexicon`, `phrase`, `builtin:<check>` (wrap current always-lane checks: empty_leadin, vague_claim, uniform_cadence, redundancy, unsupported_certainty, density, etc.).
- Normalization pre-pass: zero-width removal, Cyrillic/Greek homoglyph folding.
- Built-in "AI-writing tells" policy pack ported from avoid-ai-writing (MIT; keep attribution and NOTICE): significance inflation, vague attribution, "not X, it's Y", generic conclusions, chatbot artifacts, tiered word table.
- "Candidate → finding" gate: per-detector context exceptions before a match becomes a finding.
- Optional `nlp` extra (e.g. spaCy) for passive voice and similar checks.

## Done when
- All existing editorial fixtures pass through the policy path.
- AI-tells pack has a regression corpus with false-positive cases.
